name: remind
description: 提醒：在用户指定的时间（一次、每天、每周或间隔）通知用户一段文字。

tools.name: create
tools.description: Remind the user of text at a time. rule: JSON {kind:at,at:ISO} | {kind:daily,time:HH:MM} | {kind:weekly,days:[0-6],time} | {kind:every,minutes>=5}, in the owner's timezone; recurring activity gets a recurring rule. label: short name the user sees, in the user's language. The same rule, text and label again is the same reminder. Returns the reminder's key.

text.description: What the user is reminded of

until.description: Optional ISO time after which a recurring reminder stops

tools.name: list
tools.description: Active and paused reminders, soonest first, with their keys.

tools.name: cancel
tools.description: Cancel the reminder with that key; { cancelled: false } when there is none.
